signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.formTagline: Sign in to keep your tasks moving.
signIn.helperEmpty: Enter your email and password to continue.
signIn.refusal: That email and password do not match.

tasks.mainLabel: The task list and its create form
tasks.heading: Your tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Add the first one.
tasks.completedNote: Completed tasks stay here until you delete them.
tasks.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see your tasks.

share.mainLabel: The invitation screen and the collaborator list
share.heading: Share this task
share.inviteTagline: Choose who can view or edit this task.
share.roleHint: Viewers can read. Editors can complete the task.
share.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see this task's collaborators.

preferences.heading: Notification preferences
preferences.tagline: Choose whether to receive task updates by email.
preferences.digestTagline: Receive grouped task updates in your inbox.
preferences.unsubscribedNote: You are unsubscribed from the email digest.
preferences.unsubscribeHint: You can also unsubscribe using the link in any email.
preferences.saveRefusal: We couldn't save your preference. Try again.
preferences.loadRefusal: We couldn't load your preferences. Try again.
preferences.sessionEnded: You need to sign in again before your notification preferences can load.

unsubscribe.heading: Unsubscribe from email
unsubscribe.tagline: Stop the task digest for this address.
unsubscribe.tokenMissing: This unsubscribe link is missing its token.
unsubscribe.refused: We could not unsubscribe you. This link may have expired.

plan.mainLabel: The usage screen and its upgrade action
plan.heading: Plan and usage
plan.progressLabel: Tasks used against your free plan cap
plan.atCap: You have used all {cap} active tasks on your free plan — the next task you try to create will be refused.
plan.overCapCount: You have {count} active tasks, which exceeds your free plan limit of {cap}.
plan.overCapPaused: Task creation is paused. Your free plan allows {cap} active tasks.
plan.overCapNote: Your existing tasks are safe. Complete or delete tasks to make room, or upgrade for no task cap.
plan.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see your plan usage.
plan.checkoutRefusal: Checkout could not be started. Try again from this page.

recur.heading: Repeat this task
recur.timeZoneHint: Uses your selected local time zone.
recur.startDateHint: The first time this task should occur.
recur.endConfirm: End this rule? No new occurrences are created; the occurrences already materialised are kept.
recur.endedNote: This rule has ended, so it will not create new occurrences; the rows above are kept.
recur.refusalN: Enter a number of days greater than zero.
recur.refusalDayOfMonth: Enter a day of the month from 1 to 31.
recur.refusalTime: Enter a time of day as HH:MM.
recur.refusalTimeZone: Enter an IANA time zone, like Europe/Berlin.
recur.refusalStartDate: Enter a start date as YYYY-MM-DD.
recur.refusalNoTask: Open a task’s schedule before saving a rule.

privacy.mainLabel: The privacy screen - request erasure, export data
privacy.heading: Privacy and your data
privacy.tagline: Manage the data linked to your account.
privacy.exportTagline: Get a copy of your personal activity records.
privacy.exportRefusal: We couldn't prepare your export. Try again.
privacy.exportSessionEnded: You need to sign in again before your data can be exported.
privacy.erasureTagline: Remove information that identifies you from the activity log. This cannot be undone once completed.
privacy.erasureComplete: Your erasure request is complete. Information that identifies you has been removed from the activity log.
privacy.erasureRefusal: We couldn't submit your erasure request. Try again.
privacy.erasureSessionEnded: You need to sign in again before your erasure request can be submitted.
